ChallengeCreate.description:
A new challenge, always created as a draft. The metric follows from the type:
steps for a run, metres for a swim or a ride.
ChallengeCreate.title: ChallengeCreate

ChallengeDetail.description: A challenge with its checkpoints, how many joined, and where the caller stands.
ChallengeDetail.title: ChallengeDetail

ChallengeMetric.description: What a challenge counts: steps for a run, metres for a swim or a ride.

ChallengeUpdate.description:
The fields to change, all optional. A field that is sent replaces the stored value
(`null` clears the cover, city and landmark); one that is left out stays. The service
checks the result against the same rules as `ChallengeCreate`, since a rule such as the
gold medal at the target depends on stored fields the request may not repeat.
ChallengeUpdate.title: ChallengeUpdate

DailyActivityIn.description:
What the health data said for one calendar day on the device. A figure the user did not
allow, or the device has none of, is left out.

MedalInput.description:

thresholds against its target) are checked by `ChallengeCreate`.

ProfileRead.description: The caller's profile. A user who never saved one reads as all `null` and `metric`.
ProfileRead.title: ProfileRead

ProfileWrite.description:
The body of `PUT`: the whole profile. All nine keys are required, so a client that forgets
one gets a `422` instead of wiping a stored value. `null` clears a value, except for
`unit_system`, which is never `null`.
ProfileWrite.title: ProfileWrite

ProgressRead.description:
How far the caller is in a challenge. `tracked` is false for a type whose progress the
app does not count yet (swim and cycle): its `current_value` stays 0.
ProgressRead.title: ProgressRead
